cbv27:3.1: Just as, reverend Gotama, one might set upright what has been overturned,
cbv27:3.2: or open up what has been closed, or show a path to one who is lost,
cbv27:3.3: or bear an oil lamp in the darkness so that one who has eyes can see forms,
cbv27:3.4: just so has the Dhamma been made clear by reverend Gotama in more than one way.
cbv27:4.1: I go to the reverend Gotama for refuge,
cbv27:4.2: and to the Dhamma, and to the Saṅgha of monks.
